hook: A Waymo robotaxi froze in a flooded San Francisco street, *blocking one of the only open lanes*
caption:
Water was spouting from manholes on Oak Street in San Francisco on November 18 when this Waymo stopped right in front of it.
It blocked one of the few lanes cars could still use, SFist reported.
Other Waymos stalled across the city, and the company paused its robotaxi service for the rest of the day.

Would you still get in a robotaxi when it rains?
